import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a count plot for transaction type with hue as is_fraud
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='viridis')

# Add axis labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Transaction Counts by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=15)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
